name: Gujō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gujō city emblem in green, light blue and orange: a green ring open at the fly enclosing a light blue stylised figure with an orange head.
history: Municipal flag of Gujō, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 August 2004.
